test_upload_paste_rs: test uploading text content to paste.rs and verifying the returned URL
test_upload_dpaste_com: test uploading text content to dpaste.com as a fallback paste service
test_upload_to_pastebin: test the combined upload function that tries paste.rs first then falls back to dpaste.com
test_read_full_log: test reading log files from HERMES_HOME/logs with truncation and rotation fallback
test_collect_debug_report: test collecting a debug report that includes system dump output and all log files
test_run_debug_share: test the debug share CLI command that uploads report and logs to paste services
test_delete_paste: test deleting a paste from paste.rs via HTTP DELETE request
test_schedule_auto_delete: test scheduling automatic paste deletion by recording URLs to pending.json
test_sweep_expired_pastes: test sweeping expired paste entries and deleting them with network failure handling
test_run_debug_delete: test the debug delete CLI command for removing uploaded pastes
